ROOT MATHEMATICAL PREPARATION: EXACT POISSON-COUNT TRANSFER WITH PAID RANDOM-LENGTH BOUNDARY
10 November 2026 Brisbane. A conditional exact-law reduction and conditioning counterexample, not a solved Poisson coupling primitive, all-regime rate, or novelty claim.

MODEL AND CORE HYPOTHESIS. P,Q are arbitrary fixed laws on finite[d], including zeros. The original task supplies the ACTUAL ordered X~P^m, m>=1, and only fresh independent P/Q samples and fair bits. Assume a Poisson-count core with input A0 having ENTIRE law product_i Pois(m P_i). It sees A0 and fresh P/Q samples/bits only, and returns B having ENTIRE law product_i Pois(m Q_i), with
 E||A0-B||1/2 <= m*(TV(P,Q)+zeta).
The core's uniform expected new-query bound is C_Poi(d,m,zeta), and its uniform expected local-bit-work bound is a given finite computable function of d,m,zeta. Its input's acquisition is not part of this conditional fresh-query bound. No individual probability/intensity oracle, independent per-label sampler, free archive, or unconstructed core is supplied by the reduction. Coordinate independence is an input/output distributional condition, not an access grant.

EXACT TRANSFER THEOREM. There is an original-row algorithm with ENTIRE ordered output law Q^m, expected mismatch at most
 TV(P,Q)+zeta+beta_m/m,
and expected fresh queries at most C_Poi(d,m,zeta)+beta_m,
where beta_m=2*m*Pr(Pois(m)=m)<=sqrt(m).
Its expected local work is that of the core plus O((m+d+1)*poly(log(m+d+2))) with a fixed computable polynomial; no cap or exponential stopping moment is required.

SOURCE POISSONIZATION USING THE ACTUAL ROW. Let A=count(X) and draw N~Pois(m) independently of all source data. If N<m, select a uniformly random N-subset from the actual m stored positions, using only A and fair-bit hypergeometric/type sampling; its count is A0. If N>m, add exactly N-m independent fresh P replies to A, giving A0. If N=m use A itself. Conditional on N, A0~Mult(N,P), and summing the Poisson-multinomial generating function gives independent Pois(mP_i) coordinates exactly. Pathwise ||A-A0||1=|m-N|. Fresh P overhead is (N-m)+, not an uncharged new N-row. All decisions for the core see counts, not the original ordering.

TARGET DEPOISSONIZATION WITH EXACT LAW. Run the hypothetical core on A0, obtaining B. Put N'=sum B_i, whose marginal law is Pois(m). Conditional on N'=n, B has exactly Mult(n,Q); no independence
